title: For My Kingdom Card Game Tralier
author: DarkColorsBamya1
selftext:
Greetings everyone,

Since I don't have a background in 2D drawing/art, I made extensive use of AI tools during the visual production process while developing my first Steam game, "For My Kingdom". The game is a card game with multiple endings shaped by your choices.

AI was not used for dialogues, music, and sound effects; it was only used to assist in visual production.

The game is out on Steam now! If you'd like to check out how AI was utilized by an indie developer and support the project, you can review it on the Steam page and add the game to your Wishlist:

Link:[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5096450/For\_My\_Kingdom](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5096450/For_My_Kingdom)

comments.author: Fury0022
comments.body: The game looks really good, the atmosphere feels solid. Are we talking to the same people all the time, or is there variety?

comments.author: bemren
comments.body: I really like the details. One comment about the card-flipping animation at 0:10: the cards get bigger while flipping, and I don’t think that looks very good. I think it would look better if they stayed the same size during the flip.

replies.author: DarkColorsBamya1
replies.body:
Thanks so much for the kind words! I really appreciate the feedback and I’ll definitely keep it in mind. I remember feeling like it had a bit less impact when I first tried making them the same size, but I’ll give it another shot and see how it feels.

Also, if you enjoyed it, I’d really appreciate it if you could add it to your wishlist and support the game!
